global_year_arc_principles: This artifact decides macro month posture only; it does not generate transactions, exact daily sequence, exact dated spends, balances, or raw AA payload.
Most months are boring or mildly active; pressure and stress months are intentionally limited.
Catalog item IDs are references that allow later month/day planners to select plausible events; they are not coverage targets.
Recurring obligations continue unless an explicit persona-compatible exception is listed for that month.
Self-transfers must remain visible paired movements across persona-owned accounts and must not be classified as income or spending.
Friend reimbursements, family transfers, and claim reimbursements remain ordinary external flows in raw data and must not be product-side labels.
Card purchases later post to credit card accounts first; deposit accounts show impact only when card bills are paid.
Simpl/pay-later is only available to Aarav, only near salary-end, and never for Priya.
Large one-time inflows are not introduced to rescue bad planning; planned salary, lagged reimbursements, and justified liquid fund movements are the only allowed liquidity supports.

Stress clusters must remain coherent; do not combine travel, hospital, gadget purchase, insurance, tax, and card stress unless the month is explicitly selected as the single stress month and still passes plausibility.
